jobs.title: Structural Engineer, Starship Tower
jobs.description_text: STRUCTURAL ENGINEER, STARSHIP TOWER The Starship catch tower will redefine ground support systems for launch vehicles as we know them, with the ultimate goal of launching, catching, and relaunching orbital boosters in hours or days instead of weeks or months. The tower the largest steel structure ever built to support a launch vehicle. It must survive the acoustic, thermal, and blast environment of the most powerful rocket in the world at liftoff, absorb the loads of catching a returning booster, and then be ready to do it again within days. As the Structural Engineer on the Tower team, you will own the structural integrity of these structures from concept through fabrication, erection, activation, and launch operations. You will perform and own the structural design and analysis of primary and secondary steel, connections, anchorage, and foundation interfaces; develop and issue drawings, calculations, and specifications; and lead consulting engineers, fabricators, and construction contractors through engineering, procurement, fabrication, construction, and commissioning. You will work hand in hand with the mechanical, mechanisms, fluids, and analysis engineers on the team to ensure the structure meets requirements for both the design and the manufacturing and integration processes. jobs.description_text: SUPERVISOR, HARDWARE RELIABILITY (STARLINK) At SpaceX we’re leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world’s most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world’s largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to millions of users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. jobs.description_text: POSITION PURPOSE: The 1st Vice President, Compliance for CIM is responsible for supporting the CCO of CIM and a CIM affiliate, OFS Management (“OFS”), in ensuring that OFS maintains a compliance program reasonably designed to comply with applicable federal, state and local laws, rules and regulations. ICG includes regional institutional sales teams across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC—primarily serving pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, and endowments—as well as the Financial Institutions Group (FIG), which serves major insurance companies and banks, and Global Consultant Relations (GCR), which works with investment consultants, OCIO providers, and other asset managers. This role works alongside senior team members, contributes to key fundraising initiatives, and offers direct exposure to some of the world’s largest and most sophisticated institutional investors and intermediaries. As a visible member of a collaborative, high-performing team, the successful candidate will gain hands-on experience, develop critical skills, and build a strong foundation for a successful career at a respected and growing investment firm. You'll help get the right parts to our factory floor on time and at the right cost. This is a hands-on internship. You'll place real purchase orders, work directly with suppliers and freight carriers, and see the parts you buy become hardware that ships to customer sites.

jobs.title: Global Supply Manager (Austin, TX)
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a hands-on Global Supply Manager with exceptional negotiation skills to establish and manage commercial relationships with contract manufacturers and strategic partners. In this role, you will own cost negotiations, supply planning, and risk management while driving cost reduction through operational efficiency and disciplined processes. You will be instrumental in executing projects that meet both product milestones and corporate goals. This role sits at the intersection of internal engineering teams and external manufacturing partners, requiring someone who can balance competing priorities to ensure successful product launches. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-moving environment, drives excellence across their own responsibilities and those of team members and partners, and communicates concisely and effectively with senior leaders and cross-functional peers alike. This employee will be based in Austin, TX, and will also work from our Miami headquarters as needed. Relocation to Austin, TX is required, and relocation assistance will be provided.

jobs.title: Global Supply Manager MBA Spring Intern (Austin)
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a Global Supply Manager MBA Intern to join our Supply Chain & Manufacturing team in Austin for the Spring 2027 term, January 12 to April 16, 2027. You'll work alongside our Global Supply Managers on the commercial side of building P3: choosing contract manufacturers and suppliers, negotiating cost, planning supply and managing risk as we move from first units toward volume production. This is a strategic internship with real stakes. You'll own a sourcing project from analysis to recommendation, sit in on supplier negotiations, and present your findings to Supply Chain & Manufacturing leadership.

Your work will span the factory floor and the supply base: developing how P3 modules are assembled, and helping negotiate with the suppliers who keep materials flowing. You'll see end to end how a hardware company scales from early units to volume production.

jobs.description_text: We are hiring a Core Software Engineer to deliver reliable 5G Core network functions and control-plane services that support next-generation mobile and satellite networks. You will architect, develop, and maintain critical network functions and control-plane services that form the backbone of next-generation mobile telecommunications infrastructure. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who takes responsibility for results, makes timely decisions, and stays engaged until the solution works. You will apply your knowledge of 3GPP protocols, distributed systems, and service-oriented architecture to advance our 5G Core processing solutions and turn technical commitments into working software.

jobs.title: Director, Payload Electronics, Space Communications Systems
jobs.description_text: Your Mission Deliver payload electronics the program can count on, working for its users in space on a record schedule. Turn a signal-chain architecture with noise, linearity, timing and power budgets, a sequenced plan, accountable owners and hardware that passes test. Velocity of decision making is paramount: you close architecture trades in days, not quarters, and you build that pace into every engineer on the team.

jobs.description_text: We are looking for a hands-on Electrical Test Engineer to own electrical verification and electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) for E-Space’s integrated antenna assembly. You will build and troubleshoot electrical test setups, solder test hardware, write test software (Labview, Python), configure and run data acquisition (DAQ) systems, and operate spacecraft and instrument surrogates for verification testing. This is an electrical engineering role with substantial bench and test facility work. You will own the electrical test chain from the hardware connection through acquisition, automation, and recorded evidence. During environmental campaigns, you will work alongside the engineer responsible for mechanical testing, providing electrical test support and functional verification. On-site in Arlington, Texas. Hands-on bench work and test facility presence are required. Some travel between sites expected.

jobs.title: Facilities Security Officer
jobs.description_text: THE ROLE: We’re seeking an experienced Facilities Security Officer (FSO) who can lead, design, and execute a comprehensive industrial security program for a classified “possessing” facility. This role will also serve as the Insider Threat Program Senior Official (ITPSO), responsible for developing and maintaining a proactive insider threat and awareness program. You’ll be joining E-Space at a pivotal moment — helping establish our cleared operations from the ground up and ensuring compliance with the National Industrial Security Program (NISP), DoD 5220.22-M (NISPOM), and related directives.

jobs.title: Internal Communications Manager
jobs.description_text: We are hiring an Internal Communications Manager to build the systems, channels, and culture programs that keep E-Space informed and connected as we grow from about 350 to 1,000+ employees over the next 18 months. You will take what exists and build the infrastructure that makes E-Space feel like one coherent company, where people understand the mission, see how their work connects to it, and want to show up. This is a builder role. You will balance two equally important missions: owning the systems that keep the company aligned, and partnering with the People team on the culture programs, celebrations, and spaces that make work feel meaningful. You will work in an environment with competing asks, real ambiguity, and high expectations, and you will need to make calls about what gets done, in what order, and what does not, without waiting for permission. This role is internally facing. E-Space is in Stealth Mode while we build our technology, so the role does not include external communications or PR. It reports to the Head of People and operates as a shared service between the executive leadership team and the broader company.

jobs.description_text: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

jobs.description_text: The E-Space Manufacturing team builds the world's most advanced aerospace products at high rate and high precision. As a Senior Controls Engineer, you'll architect, program, and deploy the Beckhoff-based control systems that run our robotic and precision-assembly lines. You'll be the dedicated controls owner the team needs - relieving today's reliance on a handful of people - and combine strong software design with hands-on hardware integration to deliver world-class reliability and throughput. This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering leadership team.

The target base pay for this position in Santa Clara, California is $140,000 - $200,000 annually. The total compensation package will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job-related knowledge, skills, and experience and location. We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used—so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in-orbit activities. If that’s your experience – then we’ll be immediately wow-ed. E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role.

You'll work hands-on in SolidWorks alongside a Staff designer and the broader manufacturing team, owning subsystems end-to-end and bringing them from concept to qualified production hardware. This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering leadership team.

We are seeking a Senior Patent Agent to take substantial ownership of patent preparation and prosecution across these technologies. Working directly with Lead IP Counsel and engineering teams, you will turn complex inventions into high-quality patent applications and pursue commercially meaningful claim coverage. This is a hands-on role: approximately 60% of your time will involve drafting applications, with approximately 30–40% devoted to prosecution. You will personally draft most assigned applications and all U.S. Office Action responses for assigned matters, and review outside counsel’s non-U.S. Office Action responses. The role calls for an experienced practitioner who can produce high-quality work with limited supervision and is proficient using AI-based tools effectively.

jobs.title: Senior RF Front-End Design Engineer - Satellite User Terminals
jobs.description_text: E-Space is seeking a Senior RF Front-End Design Engineer to develop transmit and receive electronics for satellite communication user terminals. This is a hands-on role for an engineer who can translate system and link requirements into robust RF hardware and take designs from architecture through device-level circuit design, PCB implementation, prototype bring-up, validation, and production release. The successful candidate will work closely with antenna, modem, baseband, firmware, power, mechanical, thermal, test, and manufacturing teams to deliver efficient and reliable user-terminal RF hardware. On-site in Arlington, Texas. Occasional travel may be required. This is a full time, exempt position, based out of our Arlington, TX facility. The target base pay for this position is $160,000 - $195,000 annually. The total compensation packaged will be determined by various factors such as your relevant job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We are redefining how satellites are designed, manufactured and used—so we’re looking for candidates with passion, deep knowledge and direct experience on LEO satellite component development, design and in-orbit activities. If that’s your experience – then we’ll be immediately wow-ed. E-Space is not currently able to provide employment sponsorship for candidates who do not hold work authorization for the location of this role.

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Engineer
jobs.description_text: The E-Space Manufacturing team builds the world's most advanced aerospace products at high rate and high precision. As a Senior Robotics Engineer, you'll program and integrate the ABB and Fanuc robots that assemble our satellites. You'll own robotic cells end-to-end - from path planning and EOAT integration to commissioning and cycle-time optimization - and serve as the dedicated robotics owner the team needs as we scale. This is a hands-on role for someone who has deployed industrial robots in production and wants to build a robotics function from a strong foundation. This position reports to the Manufacturing Engineering leadership team.

jobs.title: Senior Scheduler
jobs.description_text: We are scaling a portfolio of U.S. Government programs, and are hiring the person who will own how this company plans and schedules that work. This is not a role that inherits a scheduling function. You will define it. You will set the scheduling standard, build the toolchain and templates, establish the status and baseline control process, support Program Managers and technical leads to work within it, and then own the Integrated Master Schedule for the portfolio on an ongoing basis. We are looking for a career space program scheduler — someone who has built and defended an IMS on satellite, payload, or ground systems development programs. You will have direct authority over scheduling methodology across Government Programs.

jobs.title: Senior Structural Dynamics Analyst, Deployable Antenna Structures
jobs.description_text: We are looking for a hands-on Electrical Test Engineer to own electrical verification and electrical ground support equipment (EGSE) for E-Space’s integrated antenna assembly. You will build and troubleshoot electrical test setups, solder test hardware, write test software (Labview, Python), configure and run data acquisition (DAQ) systems, and operate spacecraft and instrument surrogates for verification testing. This is an electrical engineering role with substantial bench and test facility work. You will own the electrical test chain from the hardware connection through acquisition, automation, and recorded evidence. During environmental campaigns, you will work alongside the engineer responsible for mechanical testing, providing electrical test support and functional verification. On-site in Arlington, Texas. Hands-on bench work and test facility presence are required. Some travel between sites expected.

jobs.title: Wireless Test and Automation Engineer - 5G PHY & Stack
jobs.description_text: Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place! E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems. We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.

jobs.description_text: That mission shapes how we work. At FireMon, being proactive is rewarded, and your work has a direct line to the product our customers rely on and to the success of the business. You’ll share ideas, collaborate across departments, and learn parts of the company beyond your own role. THIS POSITION IS FULLY REMOTE AND NOT BASED WITHIN A FIREMON OFFICE The Customer Support Engineer will leverage strong technical awareness, research skills, and equally strong customer service skills. You will be responsible for engaging with customers via chat, meeting software, email, and phone to work toward a technical resolution of FireMon products. Due to the complexity and breadth of the FireMon products supported, strong research and documentation skills are key to success in this role. For technical issues that cannot be resolved the Customer Support Engineer will follow documented processes to prepare and escalate the ticket to an advanced solutions engineer.

jobs.title: Director, GTM Operations
jobs.description_text: The Director of GTM Operations will own the systems, processes, data, and measurement framework that power FireMon’s global go-to-market organization, spanning Marketing, Sales, Partners, and Customer Success, while serving as a strategic partner in improving full-funnel GTM performance. Reporting to the VP of Revenue Operations, this role will lead GTM systems and Salesforce architecture, marketing automation, lead-to-revenue lifecycle management, attribution, and GTM tech stack optimization. Just as importantly, this leader will use data to diagnose funnel performance, identify conversion gaps and operational issues, and translate findings into recommendations that improve campaigns, programs, and pipeline outcomes. A key focus of the role will be modernizing GTM operations through automation and AI. The Director will identify opportunities to streamline workflows, accelerate reporting and analysis, improve data quality, and leverage tools such as Claude to uncover insights and support better decision-making. The ideal candidate combines deep hands-on GTM operations expertise across marketing and sales with strategic thinking, technical fluency, strong analytical skills, and a builder mindset.

jobs.title: RevOps Analyst
jobs.description_text: We're looking for a Senior Revenue Operations Analyst to be the analytical engine behind our GTM organization. You'll own pipeline reporting and forecasting, run and improve our Salesforce environment and GTM tech stack, and support annual territory, quota, and capacity planning. You'll partner with Sales leadership, Finance, Marketing, and CX to turn data into decisions that drive predictable revenue growth. A key focus of the role will be modernizing GTM operations through automation and AI. You' ll identify opportunities to streamline workflows, accelerate reporting and analysis, improve data quality, and leverage tools such as Claude to uncover insights and support better decision-making. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description_text: FireMon delivers Network Security Policy Control for the Modern Enterprise. Most enterprises run firewalls from multiple vendors alongside cloud security groups and microsegmentation platforms, and no single console can say whether it all works together. We believe policy is the control plane for network security: it defines what the environment should do, and the infrastructure carries it out. FireMon gives security teams one place to see, govern, and prove that their policy is doing what they intend, across on-prem, cloud, and hybrid environments The Software Engineer will work with Product Management and other Engineers to design, develop, and maintain network device integration software.

jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Corporate Controller to our team. In this role you will oversee the accounting function responsible for general ledger accounting, financial close, reconciliations, and accounting compliance. This role establishes functional priorities and operating plans, manages accounting teams through subordinate leaders, and maintains accounting policies and controls that support accurate and timely financial reporting. The Corporate Controller evaluates financial results, complex accounting matters, internal controls, and operational performance to ensure accounting activities comply with applicable standards and organizational requirements. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, technically strong accounting leader with experience in complex multi entity environment and exposure to SEC reporting and SOX controls. This position requires an experienced accounting leader with deep knowledge of financial reporting, generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) or International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS), internal controls, and audit requirements. The Corporate Controller partners cross-functionally with finance, operations, program management, and other business functions to address financial matters, improve accounting processes, and provide senior leadership with accurate and meaningful financial information.

jobs.title: Director of Global Rewards
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Director of GlobalRewards to our team. In this role you will lead a strategic function that directly enables CesiumAstro’s mission by designing and delivering competitive, equitable, and innovative compensation and benefits programs that attract, retain, and engage top talent. This role partners closely with senior leaders to develop and execute a total rewards strategy aligned with business objectives, ensuring our compensation and recognition programs support our growth trajectory and reinforce our unique culture. Global Rewards is a mission-critical capability that impacts our ability to compete for specialized talent in the high tech and space & defense sectors while fostering an environment where team members feel valued and motivated to contribute to our bold mission. This leader will build and scale modern global rewards programs, leveraging data analytics and market intelligence to design offerings that meet diverse workforce needs while optimizing investment and ensuring compliance. The Director of Global Rewards oversees compensation strategy, equity programs, recognition initiatives through a holistic approach to rewarding performance and contribution. Additionally, this role serves as a key direct report and advisor to the Vice President of Human Resources, and partners in enhancing partnership with the Board Compensation Committee and providing strategic guidance on executive compensation and equity programs.

The Director oversees a team of Applications Engineers who serve as technical experts on the company’s products and act as a critical interface between customers, Product, Engineering, Business Development, and program execution. The Director owns the Voice of the Customer within the product organization, ensuring that customer needs, integration challenges, operational experience, and product feedback are translated into actionable product requirements, roadmap priorities, documentation, tools, and improvements. Supporting customers throughout the product lifecycle—from early product evaluation and pursuits through integration, test, deployment, and on-orbit or operational support—the Applications Engineering organization focuses on making complex communication products easy to adopt, integrate, and successfully operate.

The Payload Lead is responsible for the technical development of a new payload product consisting of a phased array (AESA) and a processing unit (RPU). This combines deep, multi-disciplinary technical accountability with responsibility for on-time schedule execution. The Payload Lead is the leader of the multidisciplinary technical team, the primary point of contact for the program manager, and often a key interface point for our customers. Success in this role requires deep expertise in technical topics as well as project management, leadership, and communication in a fast-paced startup environment.

Interns in the Analog & Power team are typically responsible for design projects that directly contribute towards an on-going program or contribute towards advancing the Analog & Power Electronics team’s technology development road map. Interns will also gain valuable experience in hands-on laboratory characterization and troubleshooting of power electronics. jobs.title: Supervisor Quality Control
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Supervisor, Quality Control to our team. In this role you will monitor daily inspection and quality control activities to ensure hardware meets engineering specifications, customer requirements, and established aerospace quality standards. This role assigns inspection work, coordinates personnel and resources, monitors productivity, and reviews inspection results and documentation for accuracy and completeness. The Supervisor addresses routine product quality concerns, maintains established inspection procedures, and supports consistent product acceptance and manufacturing operations. This position requires an experienced quality control professional with practical knowledge of inspection methods, product acceptance, nonconformance control, and quality management systems. Working closely with Manufacturing, Engineering, Operations, and Quality Assurance, the Supervisor coordinates inspection priorities, communicates quality concerns, and supports resolution of issues affecting daily workflow, production schedules, and product conformity.

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Partner
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add a Talent Acquisition Partner to our team. If you enjoy working in a startup environment and are passionate about hiring top talent to work on satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will be responsible for building a pipeline of candidates to help develop leading-edge electronics for satellites, spacecraft, and aerospace systems. You will collaborate with hiring managers and key stakeholders to identify, attract, and hire top talent in various disciplines within the aerospace industry. This is a multifaceted job that requires strong technical aptitude and the ability to effectively assess the technical capabilities of candidates, along with outstanding organizational skills and the ability to understand and promote the value proposition Cesium offers. Talent acquisition activities will include sourcing candidates from a variety of platforms and helping to develop high-impact recruiting strategies. You will work closely with Cesium engineering and business staff to develop and execute talent acquisition projects.

jobs.title: Test Technician III
jobs.description_text: We are looking to add an Test Technician III to our team. If you are excited about working in a startup environment, have a strong work ethic, and are passionate about cutting-edge electronics, we would like to hear from you. In this position, you will work closely with CesiumAstro engineers to create module & payload performance test setups, execute test plans, and produce timely, reliable test results. You will have the opportunity to use and maintain state-of-the-art electronics lab instrumentation, such as spectrum analyzers, VNAs, automated power supplies, and more. You will be challenged to propose and fabricate intricate test setups to increase productivity and improve test results. Many of our products include active phased arrays (a.k.a. active electronically scanned arrays, or AESAs). These are antenna products with active RF circuitry integrated with the antenna. This adds complexity to the test architecture, including power, digital control, and thermal effects. As such, direct experience with phased array (or AESA) testing is preferred. Core day-to-day activities will include aligning with engineers to test and troubleshoot complex electronics and RF circuitry from component level to system level. As such, the ability to understand and work from drawings, diagrams, schematics, and test procedures is key. jobs.title: Research Scientist Intern, AI Molecular Design (Winter/Spring)
jobs.description_text: GenBio AI is an AI for Science company on a mission to make biology fully computable. We are building AIDO (AI-Driven Digital Organism) to simulate living systems, decode biology holistically, and accelerate medical and scientific research. Our first step toward that mission is AIDO Cell, the first virtual cell world model that holistically simulates cell biology from molecules up to whole-cell behavior. It enables researchers to run experiments virtually, predicting how cells respond to genetic changes, drugs and other interventions before going into the lab. It is supported by AIDO Foundry, an AI-builds-AI engineering framework for automating virtual cell development, and AIDO Lab, an interface to digitally run experiments and observe the results. Together they form the foundation for a new paradigm in AI-driven drug discovery, bioengineering, and fundamental biomedical research.

jobs.description_text: About The Role: Hermeus is seeking a hands-on, technically rigorous Chief Engineer to lead the expansion of our High Enthalpy Airbreathing Test (HEAT) facility in Jacksonville, Florida. You will own the technical execution of the facility expansion from requirements definition and architecture through design, construction, system integration, commissioning, and operational readiness. This role will focus primarily on the embedded flight software and networking that enable communication between our aircraft and ground control systems. You will develop software supporting command and control, telemetry, network management, RF communications, and vehicle data links while working closely with avionics, RF, flight software, and ground systems engineers. This is not a traditional voice communications role. You will work on the software and network infrastructure that allow an air vehicle and ground control station to reliably exchange commands, telemetry, and other mission-critical data. The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between embedded C/C++ development, network and communications system design, and hands-on testing with target hardware. You will have ownership across both the vehicle and ground sides of the communications network and will help take systems from initial architecture through integration and flight operations.

jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description_text: At Neighbor, our vision is to bring communities together by solving our neighbors’ biggest challenges. We’re building the largest hyper-local marketplace the world has seen. We’ve raised over $65 million from top-tier investors such as Andreessen Horowitz and the creators of DoorDash, Airbnb, and Uber. To learn more, here is what one of our investors wrote after leading Neighbor’s Series A. We are searching for a Customer Success Manager to help continue building out our post-sale account management function and process. You’ll be responsible for onboarding, managing, and expanding our commercial supply partnerships, comprised of parking operators and national real estate portfolios - including some of the largest REITs in the country. You will explore innovative ways to identify and optimize partnerships to maximize revenue and partner engagement and satisfaction. Our ideal candidate is someone who thrives in an ambiguous environment where they must develop, implement, and iterate on business strategies to deliver growth and a positive experience. This role will work closely with Sales, Customer Support, Product, Marketing, and Engineering.
